biggest_catch: No annual fee ($0), so the $250 is pure upside on the fee side — the real catch is the 90-day clock on a limited-time offer that can change. Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, and if you carry a balance at the card's 17.49%–27.49% variable APR, interest erases the $250 in a matter of weeks — pay the full statement balance every month.
